ระบบนัดหมายแพทย์และคลินิกออนไลน์ แต่ละแพ: Online appointments for doctors and clinics. Each doctor has their own booking link, with time slots and a limit per slot, automatic or staff confirmation, confirmation and reminder emails, self-service cancelling and rescheduling for patients, and a schedule page for each doctor.
